description: This file defines a class 'CodeNavigationBehavior' that modifies text navigation behavior in a Kivy TextInput widget to emulate IDE-like navigation, recognizing whitespace, punctuation, and case variations.

classes.name: CodeNavigationBehavior
classes.description: A class that modifies text navigation behavior in Kivy's TextInput to work like an IDE, with methods for moving the cursor word left and right.

methods.name: _move_cursor_word_left
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the beginning of the previous word, considering whitespace, punctuation, and case variations.

methods.name: _move_cursor_word_right
methods.description: Moves the cursor to the beginning of the next word, considering whitespace, punctuation, and case variations.
